facts.fact: The Public Procurement and Disposal of Assets Authority says 32 pilot procuring entities are being onboarded onto the Malawi National Electronic Procurement System (MANePS) in Salima, and all 32 have submitted their 2025/26 annual procurement plans through it.

systems.owner: Public Procurement and Disposal of Assets Authority

MWI.note: The onboarding training is on using the procurement system, not a digital-skills programme for civil servants.
Nothing on digital skills of the public.
